source: Main PDF p9 Player Turn—Agent Turn: card from hand face up in front; Agent from Leader to unoccupied space; board-space and Agent-box effects, ignoring Reveal box
Main PDF p20 Recall Agent; tested exception in Q36
accepted.novelty: This tests the ordinary turn’s legal sources and movement, which constrain whether a player can manufacture further Agent turns by reusing placed Agents or played/discarded cards. Q04 requests costs/card capacity/no-icon legality, Q87 requests matching access icons, Q03/Q35 request later lifetime/destinations, and Q36 requests recall reuse. None requests the ordinary origin rule. This is a distinct foundational source rule, not different numbers/names or a recombination of existing cost/access cases. The question also explicitly requests the Agent-box/ignore-Reveal-box part of the same basic procedure; Q03 asks Reveal-side card eligibility, so this makes the Agent side direct without creating a standalone reverse-box variant.
